instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then pat them dry with a paper towel. If you'd like a smoother spread, pinch off any loose skins.
Halve and pit the avocados and scoop them into a large bowl with the chickpeas.
Mash with a fork or potato masher until mostly broken down. Leave a few chunks for texture.
Stir in the cilantro, green onions, the juice of both limes, the salt and the pepper.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
Toast the bread in a toaster or in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden.
Slice the tomato. Spread the mash over 4 slices of toast, about 3/4 cup on each, then add the spinach and tomato.
Top with the remaining toast and cut each sandwich in half. Eat them the same day.
method_notes: Cup of Yum (4.6 from 354) leads: canned chickpeas and avocado mashed together with cilantro, green onion and lime, spread on bread with spinach, tomato or lettuce. Scaled from 3 servings to 4 sandwiches. Simple Veganista and Kale Junkie add carrot, cucumber or onion, which are left out to keep the lead's version. No mayo or dairy is needed, so it is naturally vegan; the bread has to be a vegan loaf. It doesn't keep, because the avocado browns, so make it the same day.
